assessments.source_anchor: # Android to iOS: Feature Parity Implementation
assessments.rationale: It ports Android features to iOS and provides no method to analyze, test, explain, or improve an email regular expression.
assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Regex diagnosis, visual explanation, test cases, performance assessment, and browser and Python versions.

assessments.rationale: It directs pattern diagnosis with a plain-language and visual breakdown of anchors, groups, classes, and quantifiers; tests supplied and generated edge cases; addresses greediness and performance; and converts patterns for JavaScript and Python.
It diagnoses conversion and usability problems on a live marketing website, not failures of an email regular expression.
assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Regex diagnosis, visual explanation, test cases, performance assessment, and browser and Python versions.

assessments.rationale: It structures team retrospectives and action tracking rather than debugging a regular expression.
assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Regular-expression diagnosis, testing, explanation, and improved browser and Python patterns.

assessments.rationale: It compiles and executes a regex against positive and negative examples, iterates it, and reports test results, but does not provide the requested visual structural breakdown, greediness or performance analysis, or browser-specific version.
assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A visual breakdown plus greediness and performance analysis and an explicit browser-compatible version.

assessments.rationale: It designs a gym member-retention system and has no route for analyzing or repairing an email regular expression.
assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Regex diagnosis, testing, visual explanation, and browser and Python improvements.

assessments.rationale: It surveys documented visual and interaction conventions for product design, not regular-expression matching behavior.
assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Regex diagnosis, test execution, visual explanation, and an improved browser and Python pattern.

assessments.rationale: It tests regexes against samples, explains common constructs, warns about catastrophic backtracking, and notes flavor differences, but lacks the requested visual structural breakdown and explicit browser-version delivery.
assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: A visual breakdown and an explicit improved browser-compatible version alongside the Python version.
